comparison.objective: Pour the contents of a heavy pot into a bowl and return the pot to the stove.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanually lift, carry, and tilt a two-handled vessel while controlling granular contents.
comparison.success_condition: Required contents delivered with limited spill; pot returned upright to the stove without low-altitude tipping.
comparison.reason: The tested ability is coordinated load bearing and controlled pouring. The candidate instead tests small-feature tool use and iterative mechanical tuning.
